newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends softer at 229.20-230 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends softer at 229.20-230 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 229.20-230.00 per dollar, softer than the morning's 228.45/90, due to a slight rise of foreign currency demand on the interbank market in the afternoon, dealers said.
"(Foreign currency) demand picked up a bit, pushing down the lev to 230 per dollar at a time when only a few banks were still in the market," one dealer said, adding that turnover was low.
Dealers attributed the thin trade to the current sharp lev liquidity shortage in most banks, following a series of monetary restrictions imposed by the central bank.
"Some banks offered dollars, but there were few bidders in the market," another dealer said.
Foreign currency demand from final clients was also very low, traders said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
